scenes.headline: How JOSIE-2 was trained, and what its table mislabels
scenes.sub: One synthesized dataset, three Qwen3.5 sizes, trained on Apple Silicon.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cupcake! JOSIE-2 is a family of personality-tuned models in three sizes. Here's how they were made, and what their benchmark table gets wrong.

scenes.text: One small synthesized dataset, about 4M tokens, turns three Qwen3.5 sizes into personality models, each from its own same-size base.
scenes.say: The idea: one small, carefully synthesized dataset, reused across three model sizes. Each model starts from its own same-size Qwen base.

steps.say: It starts with data. Bigger models, including Gemma 4 and GPT-5.4, helped synthesize about three thousand five hundred samples. Around four million tokens in all.
That one dataset fine-tunes three Qwen3.5 bases, two, four and nine billion parameters, entirely on Apple Silicon.
Each JOSIE-2 model comes from its own same-size base. The configs agree on all three.

steps.note: confined to the hidden reasoning, not the reply
steps.say: One trait wasn't trained in. No reward enforced a polite inner monologue, so the hidden reasoning sometimes roasts the user.

left.title: The card's label
items: Baseline row: Qwen3.5-4B, on all three cards
left.say: The cards' benchmark tables label every baseline row Qwen3.5-4B, even on the 2B and 9B cards. So it reads as a small model beating a bigger one.

right.title: What config.json says
items: Baseline scores differ per card: each base's own
right.say: But the configs name same-size bases, and each card's baseline scores differ. It looks like a copied label, not a fabricated result.

scenes.text: A few thousand curated examples, reused across three sizes, plausibly lift each model over its own same-size base.

recap: One 4M-token dataset, reused for three sizes
Each model is fine-tuned from its own-size base
The table's 4B label reads as a template bug
scenes.say: To recap: one small dataset, three same-size bases, and a benchmark label worth checking against the config.
